# SYN4RCH query log

Generated by `python3 -m syn4rch.harvest.run`. Every query below was
actually issued; `engine_total_hits` is the search engine's own total for
that query and `ids_retrieved` is how many ids this run took from it
(capped by `--retmax`). Where they differ the query is marked truncated,
and the corpus is a relevance-ranked sample of that query, not all of it.

## Curation decisions recorded here

(`docs/DECISIONS.md` is owned by another agent, so harvest/vocabulary
decisions are logged in this file instead.)

1. **All `allen_id` values in `data/vocab/regions.json` are `null`.** The
   curator did not have verified Allen Mouse Brain Atlas structure ids to
   hand and would have had to guess the integers. A wrong atlas id is worse
   than a missing one, so all 23 are null and must be filled from a
   downloaded copy of the Allen structure graph.
2. **`higher_is` is `null` for all but four outcomes.** Direction of benefit
   is context-dependent for essentially every Tier A physiological variable.
   Only median lifespan, maximum lifespan, grip strength (better) and
   frailty index (worse) carry a value.
3. **Cre lines are listed only where the curator was confident the driver
   exists under approximately that name.** GHRH, TRH, Tbx3, VMH/DMH BDNF and
   the QRFP preoptic population therefore have empty `cre_lines` with the
   uncertainty stated in `notes`, rather than plausible-looking invented
   allele names. No JAX stock numbers appear anywhere.
4. **`resolve()` has no fuzzy matching.** Exact and curated-synonym only, so
   `None` is frequent and correct. Ambiguous acronyms (`LH`, `ARC`, `ME`,
   `ZI`, `PH`, `GH`, `T3`/`T4`, ...) are excluded from the screener's
   matchers entirely; see `AMBIGUOUS_ACRONYMS` in `screen.py`.
5. **Query term blocks are built round-robin across vocabulary entries**, not
   as a flat truncated list. A flat list cut at N silently searched only for
   opto/chemo methods and glucose outcomes; this was found and fixed before
   the real run.
6. **Queries are POSTed to E-utilities when the URL exceeds ~1.8 kB.** The
   vocabulary-generated blocks run to several kB and NCBI answers HTTP 414
   to a GET. The canonical expanded URL is still what gets logged and cached.
7. **`data/raw/` keeps every API response verbatim**, plus a sqlite response
   cache in `data/interim/`. Together these run to hundreds of MB after a
   full harvest. Provenance is mandatory (SCHEMA.md section 4) so they are
   not pruned here; `.gitignore` is owned by another agent, so whether they
   are tracked is that file's decision, not this pipeline's.
8. **`data/raw/fulltext/` can hold more files than the summary's full-text
   count.** Earlier runs with a different `--retmax` selected a different
   top-N of screened-in papers; the summary counts only records in the
   current `candidates.jsonl`, while the directory is append-only.
9. **No email address is sent to any API** (no `email=`, no `tool=`, no
   Crossref `mailto`). We stay in the anonymous pools and inside a 2 req/s
   NCBI limit instead of inventing contact details.
